items.translation: 已构建一个ConditionMessage。

items.source: Indicate the items. For example didNotFind("bean", "beans").items("x", "y") results in the message "did not find beans x, y".
items.translation: 指明项目。例如，`didNotFind("bean", "beans").items("x", "y")` 的结果是消息 "did not find beans x, y"。

items.source: items - the source of the items (may be null)
Indicate the items with a ConditionMessage.Style. For example didNotFind("bean", "beans").items(Style.QUOTE, Collections.singleton("x") results in the message "did not find bean 'x'".
items.translation: 用 ConditionMessage.Style` 标记这些项。例如，didNotFind("bean", "beans").items(Style.QUOTE, Collections.singleton("x") 生成的消息为 "did not find bean 'x'"。

items.source: Indicate the items with a ConditionMessage.Style.
items.translation: 使用ConditionMessage.Style标记这些项目。

items.source: Used when no items are available. For example didNotFind("any beans").atAll() results in the message "did not find any beans".
items.translation: 用于没有可用项时。例如，`didNotFind("any beans").atAll()` 会导致消息 "did not find any beans"。

items.source: Indicate the items. For example didNotFind("bean", "beans").items(Collections.singleton("x") results in the message "did not find bean x".
items.translation: 指示项目。例如，`didNotFind("bean", "beans").items(Collections.singleton("x"))` 会导致消息 "did not find bean x"。

items.source: Builder used to create an ConditionMessage.ItemsBuilder for a condition.
items.translation: 用于为条件创建 ConditionMessage.ItemsBuilder` 的 Builder。

items.source: Used when no items are available.
